segments.comment: B82 C-first hero-to-monster route after corrected12 verified dwarf-form tin consumption and wererat form without the unpolymorphed allmain gate. Its C map showed the hostile newt northwest of the hero after setup; the frozen northward k inputs missed that target, and a later `The newt misses!` is not hero-attack evidence. Preserve this direction miss. Corrected13 keeps the same setup and sends y (northwest) once, matching the C-observed position; it remains blocked outside recordings unless C shows a natural AD_WERE bite and the complete JS replay matches.

comment: C-first B82 hero-to-monster route corrected from run-zQIKc5: drop the +1 club, eat the C-observed boiled human-wererat tin, use #wizgenesis (the source wizard monster creation command) while still human, then shift into the corresponding wererat form and attack the adjacent newt. The prior `#monster` special-ability command is preserved as a setup miss. The artifact must show a natural AD_WERE attack through damageum/mhitm_ad_were before any parity claim.
